[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-11l[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]%hold: a reverse-%wait admission barrier[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A launch (agent or stand-alone proc) can arm a durable, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]TTL-bounded, fail-open hold that makes selected WAITING/QUEUED [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agents and un-dispatched procs wait for it to settle — never [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]touching running work — with a first-class CLI, a %hold prompt [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]directive, ACE/LSP completion, and TUI visibility.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]hold_directive.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/hold_directive.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-11l[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-11l/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Allow %queue capacity on proc units[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]queue-on-procs[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]queue-on-procs: allow %queue(capacity=) on %proc units with default [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]weight 0 so a stand-alone proc can gate on runner load and drain the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]host before dispatch.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust hold-record store and bindings[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]hold-store-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-store-core: add agent_hold.rs, a TTL-bounded fail-open [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]flock-guarded hold store under SASE home with prune-on-read, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]armer-liveness pruning, the match/exclusion predicate, and pyo3 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]hold-barrier blocker at runner-slot admission[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]hold-blocker-agents[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-store-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-blocker-agents: consult hold records under runner_slots.lock via a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new hold-barrier blocker, add agent_name to capacity records, park held [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]waiters, and release holds on family and terminal-proc settlement.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase agent hold command group[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]hold-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-blocker-agents[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-cli: add sase agent hold create/list/release/run/show plus arm and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expiry notifications, proving the runtime behind a watchable CLI before [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]any prompt surface exists.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The %hold prompt directive[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]hold-directive[dim] · [dim][/dim]after queue-on-procs, hold-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-directive: add %hold behind a new agent_holds beta flag — parsing, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directive contract entry, arm-at-launch, kin exclusion, armer priority [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]boost, approval preview, confirmation gating, and %repeat/%dispatch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rejection.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Completion and LSP for %hold[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hold-completion-lsp[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-directive[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-completion-lsp: complete %hold everywhere — new Hood value role, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hood candidate rows, WAITING/QUEUED-first agent ranking, proc rows [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]included, ACE wait-clause generalization, and xprompt LSP parity.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hold un-dispatched proc units[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hold-proc-targets[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-proc-targets: evaluate the hold predicate at the admission-engine [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]eligibility boundary so lexical and future selectors fence stand-alone [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]procs before dispatch, while dispatched procs stay immune.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]TUI, doctor, and deadlock visibility[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hold-visibility[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-visibility: surface holds — held_by on queue markers, Agents-tab [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and agent list -j rendering, a TUI hold panel modeled on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runner-limit override panel, a doctor stale-hold check, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]admission-deadlock notification.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hood selector for %wait[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]wait-hood[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-completion-lsp[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]wait-hood: give %wait a hood= keyword using the existing hood matcher, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with contract, wait-resolution, completion, and parity-test updates.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Remove the agent_holds flag and close out[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]hold-flag-removal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-directive, hold-completion-lsp, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]hold-proc-targets, hold-visibility, wait-hood[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-flag-removal: delete the agent_holds Off branch, make %hold [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unconditional, close the flag bead, run the full landing gate, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]propose the memory-documentation follow-up.[/#D7D7AF]
